content.text: About San Antonio Spurs TicketsMoving up from the ABA to the NBA in 1976, the San Antonio Spurs represent some of the rich history of the game of basketball as one of the teams to have made it from the ABA to still be alive today. And with all of their success, thanks to some of the best players of their eras, the Spurs have been one of the model franchises for the rest of the league to compete for titles with. Among the legends that have suited up for the Spurs are the duo of David Robinson and Tim Duncan. When together on the floor, Duncan and Robinson were so difficult to stop due to their ability to score on the interior and rebound the basketball. Their run together culminated in a championship, winning the NBA Finals over the New York Knicks. Duncan enjoyed a second era of success with a new group of players, with international stars Tony Parker and Manu Ginobili teaming up with Duncan to bring San Antonio multiple titles. The three players all brought the best out of one another, with Duncan's ability as a big man combining so well with Parker's ability to score and be unselfish, and Ginobili's creativity when scoring. Of course, those three players and the rest of the Spurs run of success was helped along by Gregg Popovich. One of the best basketball minds of all-time, Popovich has devised strategy after strategy to be ahead of the curve in the NBA to lead his teams to success over their rivals. Popovich cultivated the most successful period in Spurs history, the 21st century, thanks to that ability to think outside the box.How many NBA championships have the San Antonio Spurs won? The San Antonio Spurs have won five NBA championships. Their titles came in 1999, 2003, 2005, 2007, and 2014.Who are the top players on the San Antonio Spurs? As of the 2025–26 season, the top players on the San Antonio Spurs include:Victor Wembanyama – The 7’4″ phenom and 2023 No. 1 overall pick, Wembanyama is the centerpiece of the Spurs’ rebuild and a generational talent on both ends of the floor.De’Aaron Fox – The elite point guard brings scoring, playmaking, and leadership to the Spurs’ backcourt.Dylan Harper – A highly touted prospect who was taken with the No. 2 pick in the 2025 NBA Draft is expected to make an immediate impact with his scoring and versatility.Who is the biggest rival of the San Antonio Spurs? The Spurs’ biggest rival is the Dallas Mavericks, reflecting the classic Texas rivalry that has intensified over decades of competitive matchups in the Western Conference.When was the last time the San Antonio Spurs won an NBA championship? The Spurs last won an NBA championship in 2014, defeating the Miami Heat in the NBA Finals to secure their fifth title.Who is the head coach of the San Antonio Spurs? The current head coach of the San Antonio Spurs is Mitch Johnson. He was appointed on May 2, 2025, following the retirement of legendary coach Gregg Popovich, who stepped down after 29 seasons with the team. This marks the first season since the 1995–96 season that the Spurs will not have Popovich involved in coaching duties. Popovich has transitioned to the role of President of Basketball Operations for the Spurs.How much are San Antonio Spurs tickets? Ticket prices for San Antonio Spurs games depend on several factors, and they can range widely. Key determinants include seating location, opponent, game importance, and demand. Premium seats, such as courtside or VIP sections, command significantly higher prices than upper deck or standard seating. Games featuring high-profile matchups, rivalries, or playoff implications will generally cost more.Some of the main influences on ticket prices for Spurs tickets are:Opponent and importance: Spurs games against strong or popular teams typically cost more. Rivalry games, weekend or prime-time contests, and postseason play tend to draw higher demand.Seating location: Proximity to the court, club, or lower bowl access, and amenities (e.g., sideline views, VIP lounges) substantially affect cost.Venue and market size: Arenas in larger media markets or with more amenities often have higher base prices. Venue capacity, infrastructure, and premium features add to value.Timing and demand dynamics: Prices often fluctuate with supply and demand. As availability decreases or demand increases (e.g., as game day nears), prices may rise. Conversely, less Spurs popular games or advance-purchase tickets may offer savings.How can I buy San Antonio Spurs tickets? You can buy San Antonio Spurs tickets right here on SeatGeek. Showing up 60 minutes before tip-off to a San Antonio Spurs game usually hits the sweet spot. It gives you enough time to park or get dropped off, go through security (which often has lines), and walk in without rushing. You’ll also get a chance to buy food or drinks, grab some merch before stores get crowded, find your seat, and maybe catch the last part of warm-ups or Spurs player introductions. If you arrive much later, you risk missing those moments, getting stuck in lines, or being stressed trying to settle in. If you arrive much earlier, you might have too much downtime waiting. So 60 minutes balances “getting the most” and “not spending forever waiting.”Are San Antonio Spurs in the playoffs? You'll find details on playoff games, ticket availability and more!How long is San Antonio Spurs game? A regular San Antonio Spurs game consists of 48 minutes of playing time, divided into four quarters of 12 minutes each. That said, when watched in full (from tip-off to final buzzer), a Spurs game usually takes around 2 to 2.5 hours. Several factors including halftime, team timeouts, overtime, fouls, free throws, out-of-bounds plays, and other clock stoppages contribute to the additional time beyond the 48 minutes.How long is halftime at San Antonio Spurs game? Halftime at the San Antonio Spurs game, lasts about 15 minutes of real time.If the Spurs game is a nationally televised event or part of the playoffs, halftime may occasionally run a few minutes longer to accommodate broadcast schedules.What happens during halftime at San Antonio Spurs game? Halftime at the San Antonio Spurs game gives Spurs players and coaches time to rest, adjust strategy, and prepare for the second half.For fans of Spurs, halftime is also when arenas typically feature entertainment, contests, or performances, and it’s a convenient window to visit concessions or merchandise stands.How long is overtime in San Antonio Spurs game? Overtime in a San Antonio Spurs game lasts 5 minutes of game time. If the score is tied at the end of game, the Spurs game continues with an overtime period.Key points:If the Spurs game is still tied after one overtime, additional 5-minute overtimes are played until a winner is decided.Each team receives extra timeouts, and standard rules (including fouls and free throws) remain in effect.In real time, overtime usually adds 15–20 minutes or more to the overall length of the game, depending on stoppages and how many overtimes are needed.What are common in-stadium promotions or giveaways during regular-season San Antonio Spurs games?
